record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) A Government officer may not, ____________, deposit in a Bank, other than the Reserve bank or its agent for the purpose of Government transactions, moneys withdrawn from the Government Account. (Rule 9 of CTR)
record.explanation: The printed blank (a) under CTR Rule 9 bars a Government officer from depositing withdrawn Government moneys in a bank without permission, so 'without permission' completes the sentence.

record.question: Fill in the blanks: (h) The power to amend or modify these object heads and to open new Object Heads rest with Department of Expenditure of Ministry of Finance on the advice of ____________ (Rule 74)

The intended advisory body is the Controller General of Accounts, which is not an option; Comptroller and Auditor General is the nearest offered choice, so this is a low-confidence pick.
